purpose: Every retired seed `weg_id` to its final catalog id. 526 template holdings across 180 force templates resolve through these identifiers. A `split` entry means one seed sheet covered several systems that ODIN carries separately; `primary` is the part that keeps the sheet's own designation.

army_watercraft_systems.reason: A US Army acquisition PORTFOLIO page naming several watercraft programmes rather than an entity. The run's standing decision splits portfolio pages into the constituent systems ODIN already carries, so the weg_id retires with no single successor. Recorded in the crosswalk as a portfolio retirement.
